€1P. (बायति) 
__1 To dry, be dried. 
__2 To be languid or weary, be exhausted.
ind. A particle of affirmation or certainty (indeed, truly, forsooth), but it is generally used as an expletive; आपो बै नरसूनवः [[
]]; 2. 231; 9. 49; 11. 78 &c. It is also said to be a vocative particle, and sometimes shows entreaty or persuasion (अनुनय).
